en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from one of our companions, 
(It has been narrated) raising it to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Drinking of the wine is a key to all evil’.
en.sarwar: 9. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from certain persons of our people in a marfu‘ manner has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Drinking wine is the key to all evil.’”
